title: What Is Artificial Intelligence?
overview: Understand how AI is defined, the main approaches to building intelligent systems, and the key eras in the field's history.
objectives: Compare the four classic views of AI: thinking or acting, humanly or rationally
Describe major eras such as symbolic AI, expert systems, statistical learning, and deep learning
Distinguish narrow AI from the idea of general intelligence

method.title: Four definitions
method.body: Systems can be defined by whether they think or act, and whether they imitate humans or aim for rational behavior. Modern textbooks favor the rational agent view.

method.title: Historical eras
method.body: Early work centered on symbolic reasoning and search, followed by knowledge-based expert systems, then statistical machine learning and today's deep learning.

method.title: Narrow vs general
method.body: Almost every deployed system is narrow: strong at a specific task but not broadly adaptable like a person.

method.title: Hype cycles
method.body: Periods of optimism have been followed by reduced funding and interest, sometimes called AI winters.

pseudocode:
eras = ordered list of (period, dominant_approach)
for era in eras:
    describe(era.approach, era.strengths, era.limits)
print(compare(symbolic, statistical))

output.mockResult:
1950s-70s -> symbolic search
1980s -> expert systems
1990s-2000s -> statistical learning
